Title: Azure Stream Analytics: 2 new regions are now generally available

Body.Content:
Azure Stream Analytics is now generally available for customers in 2 new regions:

  • China East 2
  • China North 2

With this announcement, Stream Analytics is now available in 38 Azure regions worldwide. For more information about local pricing, visit the Azure Stream Analytics pricing webpage.
